about: A part: the moving works of a round dial gauge 0.2–0.24 m across, laid on its face over the needle the dial is drawn with — a plain off-white plate 0.146 m across over the dial's middle, a dark needle and its hub; the needle sweeps 270° clockwise from bottom left to bottom right as what it reads goes from none to full. Origin at the dial's centre on its face, facing up; turned up (rotDeg x 90) it faces south.
